items.title: Burke Stevenson Interview, 1959-06-12
items.q: And that's where I joined Kit Thomas band. I had been with him all the while. I played with him about 15, 16 years, Kit Thomas.

ctx.x: I mean, down there on Decatur?

Decatur Street. Uh, we used to wait practically all night. So, about eight till three in the morning, three or four o'clock in the morning. Uh, sometimes five o'clock. Me to play. And, uh, so after that, I got off trumpet. I started playing second trumpet with Rene at the Gypsy Tea Room. We opened up the Gypsy Tea Room. That was on, uh, St. Anne and Villaray. And bass players were scarce. And they had one of a bass players. So, they asked me, they said, Boyk, how about you, uh, trying to learn how to play bass?…
I was going to ask who else was in Kit Renee's band when you, uh, When I was playing?
